learned: All six sections and eight of ten current test groups pass. The remaining core failures prove Skill Studio can promote a package that satisfies its Studio manifest while violating the native runtime contract: missing contracts/manifest.json and resources/index.json, non-JSON-equivalent capability/skill manifests, incomplete registry package metadata, and an unreconciled specialty-map framework-only entry. Build-claim count coverage is also fixed at the prior 177-skill denominator.
next_action: Reproduce the documented startup path, trace the first real failure to its canonical owner, and repair successive blockers without running certification early.
